title: Replace trivial BCF record lifecycle leaves (bcf_init, bcf_destroy, bcf_clear) with pure Rust
description: Replace 3 trivial BCF record FFI functions: bcf_init (6 lines, struct allocation), bcf_destroy (5 lines, deallocation), bcf_clear (30 lines, field reset). All are leaves. Complexity: trivial-easy. Unlocks bcf_dup and bcf_copy.
